data.long_meaning: The name Joline is derived from the Old French word ‘joli’, meaning ‘pretty’ or ‘lovely’. In English, it is interpreted as ‘joyful little one’ or ‘little jewel’. The name has a soft, melodic sound and evokes feelings of happiness and warmth. The name Joline carries the meaning “Joyful little one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Joline usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
